video_title: Inside LeBron and Savannah James's Home, Full of Wonderful Objects | Vogue

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the significance of his championship trophies
quotes.excerpt: Sports have taught me so much about life. For me to be able to sit here with these trophies

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: Sports have taught me so much about life. For me to be able to sit here with these trophies, they all have meaningful moments, meaningful points in my life.

text_blocks.speaker: Savannah James
text_blocks.text: I think because it was that you got so close in the first year. Trying to come back to get back to that moment in the second year and actually get the championship was hard. It was a lot of mental strength that had to go into that.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the significance of his Basquiat artwork
quotes.excerpt: This is a Basquiat piece called Minor Success. All these A's that you see in the middle, he was a big fan of Hank Aaron.
quotes.quote: This is a Basquiat piece called Minor Success. If I had to think into his mind maybe a little bit, I just think it's just the beginning. As he's making his works, making his rounds, and some of his early works, he didn't have the money or the resources to actually put some of his works on canvas. This is some of the first works where he started to use the crown, and it resonated to not only me, but it resonated to our family. All these A's that you see in the middle, he was a big fan of Hank Aaron, the great baseball player that played for the Atlanta Braves, so that's kind of a nod to him there.

quotes.speaker: Savannah James
quotes.summary_phrase: Savannah James on discussing Bronny James's college decision
quotes.excerpt: The most important conversation that's happened on this couch would be Bronny's decision to go to college

text_blocks.speaker: Savannah James
text_blocks.text: The most important conversation that's happened on this couch would be Bronny's decision to go to college or where he was going to go to college, and we had a lot of those combos here with him.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: A lot of things have happened on this couch for sure. But when you have conversations about the future of your kids, it don't get no better than that.

quotes.speaker: Savannah James
quotes.summary_phrase: Savannah James on lessons learned from her children
quotes.excerpt: Bronny taught me unconditional love. Bryce taught me that I can love even more. And Zhuri has taught me patience.
quotes.quote: The lessons that each of them have taught me, I would say Bronny taught me unconditional love. That was my firstborn, my first boy. There's a connection that you get in that moment that is indescribable, so I feel like that was just true love. Bryce taught me that I can love even more, like the expansion of being able to love another human being. And Zhuri has taught me patience. Also, she has given me so much perspective. I feel like having a girl is very different than boys. For me, it just put different things in perspective just about who I wanted to be and how I wanted to show up for her.
